title: Scouting, Identification, Threshold, Cultural, and Physical Control Workbook
purpose: Provide repeatable scouting and identification records and document evidence-bounded decisions for thresholds, cultural controls, and mechanical/physical interventions.

sections.title: Representative Scouting Route
sections.decisionPrompt: Does the route provide representative coverage and enough denominator data to detect change over time?

sections.title: Identification Escalation Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Is identification confidence high enough for the proposed action, or should the case escalate?

sections.title: Threshold and Tolerance Decision Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Does the evidence justify action under this crop and risk context without pretending a universal Cannabis threshold exists?

sections.title: Cultural Control Evaluation
sections.decisionPrompt: Did the cultural change make establishment or disease development less favorable without creating a larger crop problem?

sections.title: Mechanical and Physical Control Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Was the physical intervention matched to target biology and verified with measurable follow-up?

qualityRules: Always retain denominator and location data in scouting.
Record differential diagnoses, not only the favored identification.
Document the source and context for any decision criterion.
Measure outcomes after cultural or physical controls.
